name: property-filter
purpose: One field that filters a collection by properties and free text, after Cloudscape's property filter. Typing suggests a property, then an operator, then a value, and each choice becomes a removable token (`Status = Active`); text typed without a property becomes a free-text token. Two or more tokens combine with Match all (and) or Match any (or). With `mode="query"` the same field edits one query string instead (`level = Error AND method = GET`), after the Console Kit events query bar: suggestions follow the word at the caret (a field, an operator, a value, then AND or OR), a check explains what is wrong under the field, and Enter submits the text with its flat token list. It edits a `PropertyFilterQuery` and never filters anything itself: `useCollection` (or the server) applies the query, and `propertyFilterProps` binds the query, the properties and the match count in one `v-bind`.
useWhen: A list or table that people narrow by several fields at once (status, region, owner) and by text.
Any collection driven by `useCollection`, client or server mode.
Filters that must survive a reload or a shared link: the query serializes into the URL through `useCollection`.
With `mode="query"`: an explorer (events, logs) whose users type queries by hand, keep and reuse them as text, or need a grammar of the product (pass `validate` and `suggest`).
avoidWhen: A single text search over a short list → use `input` bound to `filterProps`.
A few fixed choices always on screen → use `toggle-group` or `chip` filters.
A structured filter builder with its own panel inside a table toolbar → use `table-filter`.
related: use-collection` — applies the query; `propertyFilterProps` is the binding.
table` — the collection it usually filters.
cards` — the card form of a collection.
collection-preferences` — the panel that sits beside it in the controls row.
bestPractices: Give every property with a closed set of values its `options`, so values are suggested and tokens print labels.
Set `type: 'number'` or `type: 'date'` on ordered properties to offer `>`, `<`, `>=`, `<=`.
Bind `totalCount` so people hear how many items match after each change.
Name the field after the collection (`aria-label="Filter resources"`).

In query mode, fields are written by `key` (no spaces); quote values that hold spaces or operator characters (`"edge cache"`). Apply the `query` of `submit` when it is not null; keep the `text` for saved and recent queries.

A product grammar (`like`, `between`, parentheses) passes `validate` and `suggest`; `submit` then carries `query: null` for text the built-in grammar cannot flatten, and the product parses `text` itself.

props.name: query
props.doc: The tokens and how they combine. Supports v-model:query.

props.name: properties
props.doc: Properties the suggestions offer, with their operators and values.

props.name: totalCount
props.doc: Items that match the query, announced next to the tokens. Hidden when unset.

props.name: placeholder
props.doc: Placeholder of the field. Empty uses the locale catalog.

props.name: ariaLabel
props.doc: Accessible name of the field. Empty uses the locale catalog.

props.name: freeText
props.doc: Accepts typed text with no property as a free-text token.

props.name: disabled
props.doc: Disables the field and the tokens.

props.name: mode
props.doc: tokens` turns each choice into a token; `query` edits one query string.

props.name: text
props.doc: The query string in query mode. Supports v-model:text.

props.name: validate
props.doc: Checks the query string in query mode: '' when valid, else the message shown under the field. Replaces the built-in check.

props.name: suggest
props.doc: Suggestions for the word at the caret in query mode. Replaces the built-in field, operator, value and AND / OR suggestions.

events.name: update:query
events.notes: A token was added or removed, the operation changed, or all cleared. Tokens mode only.

events.name: update:text
events.notes: The query string changed (typing, a suggestion, Escape clearing). Query mode only.

events.name: submit
events.notes: Enter with no active suggestion and a valid query. Query mode only.

examples.name: Default
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import PropertyFilter from '@aziontech/webkit/property-filter'
  import { ref } from 'vue'

  const properties = [
    {
      key: 'status',
      label: 'Status',
      options: [{ value: 'Active' }, { value: 'Inactive' }, { value: 'Degraded' }]
    },
    {
      key: 'region',
      label: 'Region',
      options: [{ value: 'sa-east' }, { value: 'us-east' }, { value: 'eu-west' }]
    },
    { key: 'name', label: 'Name' },
    { key: 'requests', label: 'Requests', type: 'number' }
  ]

  const query = ref({
    tokens: [{ propertyKey: 'status', operator: '=', value: 'Active' }],
    operation: 'and'
  })
</script>

<template>
  <PropertyFilter
    v-model:query="query"
    :properties="properties"
    :total-count="12"
  />
</template>

examples.name: WithCollection
QueryMode
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import PropertyFilter from '@aziontech/webkit/property-filter'
  import { matchesQuery } from '@aziontech/webkit/use-collection'
  import { computed, ref } from 'vue'

  const events = Array.from({ length: 40 }, (_, i) => ({
    id: String(i + 1),
    level: ['Info', 'Warning', 'Error', 'Info'][i % 4],
    method: ['GET', 'POST', 'GET', 'DELETE', 'GET'][i % 5],
    status: [200, 404, 500, 200, 301][i % 5],
    host: ['shop.example.com', 'api.example.com'][i % 2]
  }))

  const properties = [
    {
      key: 'level',
      label: 'Level',
      options: [{ value: 'Info' }, { value: 'Warning' }, { value: 'Error' }]
    },
    {
      key: 'method',
      label: 'Method',
      options: [{ value: 'GET' }, { value: 'POST' }, { value: 'DELETE' }]
    },
    { key: 'status', label: 'Status code', type: 'number' },
    {
      key: 'host',
      label: 'Host',
      options: [{ value: 'shop.example.com' }, { value: 'api.example.com' }]
    }
  ]

  const text = ref('level = Error AND method = GET')
  const applied = ref({
    tokens: [
      { propertyKey: 'level', operator: '=', value: 'Error' },
      { propertyKey: 'method', operator: '=', value: 'GET' }
    ],
    operation: 'and'
  })

  const matches = computed(
    () => events.filter((event) => matchesQuery(event, applied.value, properties)).length
  )

  const apply = ({ query }) => {
    if (query) applied.value = query
  }
</script>

<template>
  <PropertyFilter
    v-model:text="text"
    mode="query"
    :properties="properties"
    :total-count="matches"
    aria-label="Query events"
    @submit="apply"
  />
</template>
